mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saves ( user_id, post_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{postId}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM saves WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId}

SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.caption, p.translated_caption, p.created_at, p.update_at, p.delete_at FROM saves s JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = s.post_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND p.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saves s JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = s.post_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND p.delete_at IS NULL
